opus.problem: Calling him 'Adam and Eve's firstborn son' gives the word away on its own. Most bakers know Cain as the firstborn, so this clue is not medium hard.

Two of Cain's best-known moments are missing: his reply 'Am I my brother's keeper?' (Genesis 4:9) and the mark the LORD placed on him (Genesis 4:15). Smaller details are used instead, such as Eve's words at his birth and the city named Enoch. The rule says to use the best-known stories first.
